test_title: PYST 03: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 04 Feb, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined incorrectly spelt word in the given sentence.

The next generation has become well-travelled, __tech-savyy__ and hardworking.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"tech-savyy"** is misspelt. It should be "tech-savvy". It means being proficient with technology or having a good understanding of technology. (तकनीक के जानकार)

 
 
• **Example: **In today’s digital age, being tech-savvy is almost a necessity for many jobs.
 
 
 
• Tech-savvy</strong
